احتزتن (form VIII)
# اِحْتَزْتُنَّ (iḥtaztunna) /iħ.taz.tun.na/: second-person feminine plural past active of اِحْتَازَ (iḥtāza)
# اُحْتِزْتُنَّ (uḥtiztunna) /uħ.tiz.tun.na/: second-person feminine plural past passive of اِحْتَازَ (iḥtāza)
